name: point-of-attention-ui-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Point of Attention UI — framework-agnostic 3D defect viewer (React, Vue, Angular, Blazor)

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build:vue && npm run build:angular
scripts.build:core: npm -w packages/core run build && npm -w packages/core run build:umd
scripts.build:blazor: npm run build:core && dotnet build packages/blazor/PointOfAttention.UI.Blazor.csproj -c Release
scripts.pack: npm -w packages/core pack && npm -w packages/react pack && npm -w packages/vue pack && npm -w packages/angular pack
scripts.pack:blazor: npm run build:core && dotnet pack packages/blazor/PointOfAttention.UI.Blazor.csproj -c Release -o ./artifacts/nuget
scripts.test: npm -w packages/core test && npm -w packages/react test && npm -w packages/vue test
